There's a difference between wanting something and needing it, and almost nobody is ever taught where the line is.

Wanting keeps the universe sending you more situations to want from - never to have. Needing comes from somewhere less comfortable: you let the lack actually burn, then you release your grip on the outcome completely, while still feeling as if you already have it. That release is the part almost everyone skips.

He calls what happens next broadcasting on a theta wave - instead of what he calls the poverty wave of beta. Your own brain, choosing the frequency it runs on.
